Convert a NEXUS Alignment to FASTA Format

convert_nexus2fasta.Rd

Convert a NEXUS Alignment to FASTA Format

Usage

convert_nexus2fasta(
  nexus_path,
  fasta_path = NULL,
  safe_name = F,
  remove_outgroup = NULL
)

Arguments

nexus_path

Character. Path to the input NEXUS alignment file.

fasta_path

Character or NULL. Path for the output FASTA file. If NULL, replaces \\.nexus$ in nexus_path with .fasta.

safe_name

Logical. Whether to remove underscores (_) from sequence labels. Default is FALSE.

remove_outgroup

Character vector or NULL. Sequence labels to drop before renaming. Default is NULL.

Value

Character path to the written FASTA file.

See also

Other i/o: merge_fasta()
